t: Review and improve all 65 active lugs for naming quality, detail, and PEV compliance via dogfooded improve process
description: Every active lug (61 open + 4 in_progress) must meet quality standards: meaningful name (id=filename=intent), adequate description, PEV fields where required, self-contained for cold readers. Each lug runs through the improve process, dogfooded on a fresh sub-agent to verify clarity. Multi-session work, batched by type.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Epic tracking the quality review of all active lugs across multiple sessions
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not a one-shot cleanup — this is batched, methodical quality improvement
